Put an object into a store

Source: R/store.R
dedup_put.Rd

Chunks x with the store's parameters, asks the store which chunks it already has, and writes only the others. Memory stays bounded for a connection or a file: the store is asked once per 1 MiB block, about the chunks completed in it.

Usage

dedup_put(store, x)

Arguments

store

A dedup_store() or dedup_backend().

x

A raw vector, a connection, or the path of a file. A connection that is not open is opened, read and closed; an open one must be in binary mode and is read from its current position to its end, in blocks of 1 MiB.

Value

The object's dedup_manifest(), invisibly. Keep it: it is the only way to get the object back.

Details

The default hash, XXH3-128, is not cryptographic; see dedup_store().

Examples

store <- dedup_store(tempfile(), create = TRUE)
v1 <- serialize(mtcars, NULL)
m1 <- dedup_put(store, v1)
# A second version that differs in one row writes only the changed chunks.
cars2 <- mtcars
cars2[5, 1] <- 99
m2 <- dedup_put(store, serialize(cars2, NULL))
mean(m2$hashes %in% m1$hashes)
#> [1] 0
